title: Error response
description: Body of every non-2xx API response.

message.description: Human-readable message in Hungarian, safe to show to the user.

details.description: Per-field messages (Hungarian), keyed by the dot-separated path of the offending field, e.g. {"entries.3.seq": ["..."]}; a header by its name (e.g. Idempotency-Key), the whole body by the empty key. The keys have no pattern: an unknown field is reported by the name the client sent. Present for validation_failed, optional otherwise.
